evidence.detail: The class is constructed with a human-editable config path and compiled binary path; it loads YAML through SnakeYAML when using source data and MessagePack through MessagePackMapper when using compiled data.
Its canonical payload shape is Map<Integer, Map<String,Object>>, shared by map overrides and all typed definition config subclasses.
The base can persist the in-memory structured map back to the configured YAML path using SnakeYAML DumperOptions and FileWriter.

Direct subclasses include map-region overrides, wandering-merchant item registry and the typed definition mapper base, so the class is a generic structured config store rather than a definition-specific service.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 base name for YAML/MessagePack structured config storage. No original stripped identifier is claimed.

evidence.detail: The abstract class extends StructuredConfigStore and declares one abstract mapping operation T a(int, Map<String,Object>) that converts a config record for one numeric id into typed object T.
Its load lifecycle clears the typed cache, loads the shared structured config map, iterates every configured id, invokes the abstract mapper, and stores the resulting T in an int-keyed typed cache.
Every exact-v308 concrete subclass maps config records into a client definition type: animation, NPC, spot-animation/GFX, item or object definition.
The base supplies reusable structured-value conversion helpers for byte, int[], int[][], int[][][] and String[] used by those concrete definition mappers.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the generic typed config-to-definition mapper/cache base.
